title: Terminal scrollbar
blurb: Terminals now show a scrollbar, so you can see where you are in the scrollback instead of guessing. It matches the sidebar's and follows whichever theme you are on.

title: Agent activity view
blurb: See what a Claude or Pi session is doing without reading its scrollback. ⌘J (Ctrl+Shift+J on Windows and Linux) opens an inspector beside the terminal with the agent's plan, the tools each step ran and a live timeline; in a grid, the same key turns every tile into its session's task list, with the tool feed in whatever space the tasks leave. A session whose agent stops reporting mid-turn greys out and says for how long.

title: Agent plan progress
blurb: See how far a Claude or Pi session is through its own plan without reading its scrollback: a small pie under the state dot fills as the agent works through its task list, and fades when the agent stops reporting. Turn it off per agent under Settings → Agents.

title: Sidebar redesign
blurb: Rows say each thing once: the agent is a coloured glyph instead of a repeated name suffix, the window title spans the full row, and a session's colour is a bar on the edge that doubles as its colour picker. Project and branch headers stay on screen while you scroll, a session that needs you pulses, and a density setting fits up to 40% more sessions on screen.

title: Linked sessions for a shared worktree
blurb: Sessions working in the same git worktree are grouped into one panel in the sidebar, headed by the branch they share and collapsible — so you can see at a glance which ones are editing the same files, and tell them apart by what each is actually doing.

title: Idea inbox
blurb: Press ⌘I anywhere to capture a note against a project, then start a session from it later — the launcher opens with the note as the agent's opening prompt.

title: Signed and notarized macOS releases
blurb: Downloads are signed with an Apple Developer ID and notarized, so a fresh install opens without the "unidentified developer" warning. The in-app updater refuses any release not signed by Hive, and says so plainly instead of reporting a checksum error.

title: What's new
blurb: The gift in the sidebar header lists what shipped, newest release first, and carries a dot until you have read it.

title: Sessions outlive the GUI
blurb: A small daemon owns the terminals. Quit, crash, update — your agents keep working.

title: Every agent
blurb: Claude, Codex, Gemini, Copilot, Aider, Pi, OpenCode, or a plain shell. One launcher (⌘T).

title: Grid view
blurb: ⌘G shows a project, ⇧⌘G shows everything. Arrow keys move between tiles spatially.

title: Git worktrees
blurb: ⇧⌘T spawns an agent in its own worktree. Hive refuses to delete one with unpushed work.

title: Know who needs you
blurb: A bell becomes a pulse and a desktop notification. ⌘B jumps to the agent waiting on you.

title: Undo a close
blurb: ⌘Z reopens a closed session — name, project, worktree and, where the agent supports it, the conversation.

title: Multi-window
blurb: ⇧⌘N opens another window on the same daemon.

title: 17 themes
blurb: Hive dark and light, native, terminal, plus Dracula, Nord, Gruvbox, Tokyo Night, Catppuccin, Solarized and more. ANSI palette included.

title: In-app updates
blurb: Release or latest-commit channel. Nothing downloads until you press Update. macOS only for now.

title: In-app help
blurb: A Help panel in the sidebar: what the pieces are, the keyboard shortcuts, and the links out.

title: Scrollback across daemon restart
blurb: Today scrollback lives with the daemon process.

title: Signed and notarized builds
blurb: Release zips are SHA-256 verified but not yet signed.
